_comment: Section IV Threshold Requirements, New Mexico 2026 QAP (pp.31-35). One row per lettered requirement; G's optional staff meeting (G.2) is not a requirement and is omitted. Design Standards, the Underwriting Supplement (Appendix C) and the Section I.D project eligibility rules are incorporated elsewhere and not itemised.
